case.evidence: did not enjoy refers to stars = 1; the finale episode refers to episode = 24
case.final_sql:
SELECT SUM(T1.votes)
FROM Vote AS T1
INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id
WHERE T1.stars = 1 AND T2.episode = 24
case.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.episode_id) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Vote AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.episode = 24 AND T2.stars = 1
case.question: How many people did not enjoy the finale episode?
case.root_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.person_id)
FROM Vote AS T1
INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id
WHERE T1.stars = 1 AND T2.episode = 24
